title: Holodomor
summary: A famine in Ukraine in 1932–1933, following Soviet collectivisation and high grain quotas, killed millions of people, mostly rural peasants. No official toll exists; scholarly estimates run from about 3.5 million to 7 million, with the most detailed demographic studies near 3.9 million. Russia disputes that it was deliberate.

uncertainty.note: Sources give the years 1932 and 1933 only.

importance.justification: Mass famine in Soviet Ukraine that killed millions, with its status as genocide still debated.

audience_note: Concerns a mass-death famine, with deaths by starvation and punitive seizure of food. Scholars and states disagree on whether it was intentional genocide.
